body: THIS CONTRACT IS FOR BOOKING YARN ONLY. DO NOT DYE YARN UNLESS YOU HAVE THE PO IN HAND FROM PURCHASING WITH COLOR BREAKDOWN
PRODUCTION OF FINISH FABRIC SHOULD PROCEED BASED ON QUANTITY ,COLOR BREAKDOWN AND APPROVAL IN PURCHASE ORDER.

MILL HAS TO PROVIDE FOLLOWING DOCS PRIOR TO SHIPMENT :
*INTERNAL FABRIC TEST REPORT
*SHADEBAND/SHADELOT
*INTERNAL 100% FABRIC INSPECTION REPORT
For Import & overseas shipment it is mandatory for all goods to go through a SGS Inspection at factory  before shipment cost of which is borne by the Buyer.
The Specification and HS code of the fabric in this contract are stated as declared to us by the supplier.

If SGS inspection finds non-conformity with the quantity , specification and HS of the goods the non-conformity will result in failure of shipment and extra cost will be incurred for shipment for which these costs are to be borne by the Supplier.
ANY LATE TIMELINE/DELIVERY FROM COMMITMENT - AIR SHIPMENT MAY APPLY
SHIPMENT TOLERANCE TO BE FOLLOWED. SHORTAGE MORE THAN DECLARED % - ACCESSORIES AND OR OTHER RELATED TRIMMING CLAIM WILL APPLY
THIS CONTRACT IS ONLY VALID AFTER QUALITY IS APPROVED ONLY
